description: This Java source file defines the EventWrapper class, which manages event-related data, dependencies, and code generation aspects within a larger code generation framework. It handles event variables, dependencies on other wrappers, and provides methods for dependency building and string representation of event codes.

classes.name: EventWrapper
classes.description: A class that encapsulates event variables, manages dependencies on other wrappers, and provides utility methods for event code handling within a code generation context.

methods.name: EventWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EventWrapper with an EventVariable and sets up the section mask.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Returns the underlying EventVariable associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the dependencies of this event wrapper.

methods.name: getEventCodes
methods.description: Returns the list of event codes (names) associated with this event.

methods.name: setEventCodes
methods.description: Sets the list of event codes for this event.

methods.name: getEventCodesString
methods.description: Returns a comma-delimited string of the event codes.

methods.name: buildDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes the event variable's sub-variables to identify and add dependencies on enums, other events, or custom objects.

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Adds a wrapper as a dependency and updates its section mask and language settings to match this wrapper.
